page_title: Resumemind | The Resume Builder for Software Developers

sources.entry: Resumemind - An AI-powered resume builder and visual analyzer specifically tailored for software engineers.

summary.name: Resumemind
summary.one_liner: A resume builder for software developers that lets you write resume content in forms or JSON and export as PDF, DOCX, or a live online portfolio.
use_cases: Writing an ATS-friendly resume for a software engineering job
Generating a shareable online developer portfolio from resume data
Exporting a resume as PDF or Word for tech job applications
Matching resume keywords to a job description
Tracking job applications from saved to offer
Creating a matching cover letter for developer roles
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a resume builder aimed at software developers. Resume content can be entered through forms or edited directly as JSON, with a sample resume.json shown on the page. Output options named are PDF, DOCX (Word), TXT, JSON, and a Live Portfolio hosted at resumemind.com/u/you. The page says templates are ATS-optimized and lists categories such as Modern Professional and Classic Elegant. Additional features described include uploading an existing PDF, DOCX, or image resume to extract and auto-format its data, matching a resume to a job description, and a job application tracking board. A cover letter builder and a free resume review service are also mentioned.
notable: Edit resume as JSON or through forms, with a Live Portfolio published from the data
Upload an existing PDF, DOCX or image resume to extract and reformat its content
Job description matching and an application tracking board
Free resume review by HR professionals mentioned on the page
caveats: Free tier adds a watermark on exports and limits exports to PDF, TXT, and JSON; Word export requires a paid plan
Paid plans listed: Job Hunt Pass $4.99/7 days, Monthly $14.99/month, and a one-time $149.99 plan
Page marketing claims such as '2,105,000+ devs' and 'recruiter-approved' are not independently verified
